# OpenCode SDK Reference

> Comprehensive developer reference for `packages/sdk/`
> Total: ~40 files

---

## Overview

The SDK is auto-generated from OpenAPI spec and provides type-safe API access to the OpenCode backend.

**Generated by:** `@hey-api/openapi-ts`
**Spec location:** `packages/sdk/openapi.json`

---

## SDK Structure

```
packages/sdk/
├── openapi.json           # OpenAPI specification
├── js/
│   └── src/
│       ├── index.ts       # Main entry (v1)
│       ├── client.ts      # Client factory
│       ├── server.ts      # Server process management
│       ├── process.ts     # Process utilities
│       ├── v2/            # v2 API
│       │   ├── index.ts   # v2 entry
│       │   ├── client.ts  # v2 client
│       │   ├── server.ts  # v2 server
│       │   ├── data.ts   # Message helpers
│       │   └── gen/       # v2 generated types
│       └── gen/           # Generated API types
│           ├── sdk.gen.ts  # Main SDK class
│           ├── types.gen.ts # All types
│           ├── client.gen.ts # HTTP client
│           └── client/     # Client internals
```

---

## SDK Client (`v2`)

### `v2/index.ts`
**Purpose:** Main v2 SDK entry point
**Key Exports:**
- `createOpencode()` - Creates server + client bundle
- `data` module - Message construction helpers

### `v2/client.ts`
**Purpose:** Enhanced client factory with workspace header support
**Key Exports:**
```typescript
createOpencodeClient(config: OpencodeClientConfig): OpencodeClient
```

**Key Features:**
- Auto-injects `x-opencode-directory` header
- Validates response `content-type`
- SSE support for real-time events

### `v2/data.ts`
**Purpose:** Helper for building user messages
**Key Exports:**
```typescript
message.user(parts: Part[]): UserMessage
```

---

## Generated API Types

### `gen/sdk.gen.ts`
**Purpose:** Main SDK class with all API endpoints
**Key Exports:** `OpencodeClient` class with nested resources:

```typescript
class OpencodeClient {
  session: SessionResource    // Session CRUD + messaging
  project: ProjectResource     // Project management
  config: ConfigResource       // Configuration
  provider: ProviderResource   // AI providers
  tool: ToolResource          // Tool execution
  pty: PtyResource            // Terminal
  file: FileResource          // File operations
  find: FindResource          // Search
  mcp: McpResource           // MCP servers
  lsp: LspResource           // LSP
  formatter: FormatterResource // Code formatting
  tui: TuiResource           // TUI
  app: AppResource           // App operations
  event: EventResource       // SSE events
  auth: AuthResource         // Authentication
}
```

### `gen/types.gen.ts`
**Purpose:** All TypeScript types from OpenAPI spec
**Key Types:**
- `Session` - Session metadata
- `Message` - Chat message
- `Part` - Message part (text, tool use, tool result)
- `UserMessage` - User message structure
- `AssistantMessage` - Assistant message structure
- `Config` - Configuration object
- `Project` - Project info
- `Provider` - AI provider
- Event types (`EventSessionCreated`, `EventSessionUpdated`, etc.)

## HTTP Client

### `gen/client/client.gen.ts`
**Purpose:** Low-level HTTP client with interceptors
**Key Exports:**
```typescript
createClient(config: ClientConfig): Client

// Methods
client.get(url, options)
client.post(url, body, options)
client.put(url, body, options)
client.patch(url, body, options)
client.delete(url, options)
```

### `gen/core/serverSentEvents.gen.ts`
**Purpose:** SSE client for real-time events
**Key Exports:**
```typescript
createSseClient(config): ServerSentEventsResult

// Result shape
{ stream(), response }
```

## Usage Examples

### Basic Client Creation

```typescript
import { createOpencodeClient } from "@opencode-ai/sdk/v2"

const client = createOpencodeClient({
  baseUrl: "http://localhost:3000",
})

// Use resources
const sessions = await client.session.list()
const messages = await client.session.messages.list({ sessionId: "xxx" })
```

### With Directory Context

```typescript
import { createOpencodeClient } from "@opencode-ai/sdk/v2"

const client = createOpencodeClient({
  baseUrl: "http://localhost:3000",
  directory: "/path/to/project",  // Auto-injects header
})

// All requests include x-opencode-directory header
const project = await client.project.get()
```

### Listening to Events (SSE)

```typescript
const client = createOpencodeClient({ baseUrl: "http://localhost:3000" })

// Subscribe to events
const events = client.event.list({ workspace: "default" })

for await (const event of events) {
  console.log("Event:", event.type, event.properties)
}
```

### Streaming Messages

```typescript
const stream = client.session.messages.createStream({
  sessionId: "xxx",
  body: {
    messages: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ type: "text", content: "Hello" }] }],
  },
})

for await (const chunk of stream) {
  console.log("Chunk:", chunk)
}
```

## Server Management

### `v2/server.ts`
**Purpose:** Spawn OpenCode server as child process
**Key Exports:**
```typescript
createOpencodeServer(options?: ServerOptions): ServerInstance

interface ServerOptions {
  port?: number
  workspace?: string
  env?: Record<string, string>
}
```

### `server.ts`
**Purpose:** Process lifecycle management
**Key Exports:**
```typescript
createOpencodeServer(options): ServerInstance
createOpencodeTui(options): TuiInstance
```

## API Resources Reference

### Session Resource
```typescript
client.session.list()                           // List sessions
client.session.get({ sessionId })                // Get session
client.session.messages.list({ sessionId })     // List messages
client.session.messages.create({ sessionId })    // Send message
client.session.messages.createStream({ sessionId }) // Stream response
```

### Project Resource
```typescript
client.project.list()           // List projects
client.project.get()            // Get current project
client.project.update({ body }) // Update project
```

### Config Resource
```typescript
client.config.get()             // Get config
client.config.update({ body })  // Update config
```

### Provider Resource
```typescript
client.provider.list()          // List providers
client.provider.get({ id })     // Get provider
client.provider.create({ body }) // Add provider
client.provider.delete({ id })  // Remove provider
```

### Tool Resource
```typescript
client.tool.list()             // List available tools
client.tool.execute({ body })   // Execute tool
```

### Pty Resource
```typescript
client.pty.create({ body })    // Create PTY
client.pty.resize({ id, cols, rows }) // Resize
client.pty.delete({ id })      // Close PTY
```

### File Resource
```typescript
client.file.read({ path })      // Read file
client.file.write({ path, content }) // Write file
client.file.list({ directory })  // List directory
```

## Type Generation

Types are auto-generated from `openapi.json`. To regenerate:

```bash
cd packages/sdk
bun run generate
```

This runs `@hey-api/openapi-ts` to regenerate:
- `js/src/gen/*.gen.ts`
- `js/src/v2/gen/*.gen.ts`

---

## Request Interceptors

The client supports request interceptors for middleware:

```typescript
const client = createOpencodeClient({
  baseUrl: "http://localhost:3000",
  interceptors: {
    request: (request) => {
      request.headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`
      return request
    },
  },
})
```

---

## Error Handling

```typescript
try {
  const result = await client.session.get({ sessionId: "xxx" })
} catch (error) {
  if (error.status === 404) {
    console.log("Session not found")
  } else if (error.status === 401) {
    console.log("Unauthorized")
  }
}
```
